# v3 iPad-side golden vectors. One `name<space>lowercase-hex` per line.
# The handshake inputs (k_dev, dev_id, host_id, init_ephemeral, client_nonce,
# hello) are session_golden.txt's, so message 1 is its msg1. input.* are
# fixed inputs; the rest are outputs both sides must reproduce byte for byte.
# msg2_unparseable.*: Noise authenticates, the payload doesn't parse; the
# attempt is then over and msg2_unparseable.genuine_after is refused too.
# reject_parse.<parser>.*: must not parse (session.* start with the inner
# type). replay_long.*: as replay_vectors.txt.
# Regenerate only on a deliberate wire change:
# UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p eternal-wire --lib v3::golden_client
